patent.ref: David M. Smith patented a two-arm spring clamp, US10163A; earlier one-piece pegs already existed
patent.ref_zh: 戴维·史密斯获得双臂弹簧衣夹专利 US10163A；并非所有衣夹的起源

locations.place_label_zh: 美国佛蒙特州斯普林菲尔德（史密斯弹簧衣夹专利）

notes: 本条以1853年弹簧衣夹专利为可核实节点，不将其视为衣夹整体的首次发明。
notes_en: The dated milestone is a spring-clamp patent, not the origin of every form of clothes peg.
summary_zh: 衣夹把湿衣固定在晾衣绳上。1853 年，戴维·史密斯为双臂弹簧夹申请的专利获准，使夹取衣物更方便；此前已有不带弹簧的一体式木夹。
summary_en: Clothespins secure laundry to a line. David M. Smith patented a two-arm spring clamp in 1853; one-piece wooden pegs preceded it.

image.alt_zh: 晾衣绳上的彩色塑料衣夹
image.alt_en: Colored plastic clothespins on a line
